core.title: Vitruvius Ball Cabinet Knob, Acorn PMH-C-03

text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-C-03, Stainless Steel Vitruvius Ball Cabinet Knob

The design of the Vitruvius Ball Cabinet Knob is a perfect enhancement for traditional or contemporary homes. It is designed to accentuate any setting where a modern, sophisticated look is desired. Made out of stainless steel, it comes packaged with all the necessary installation hardware. The brushed stainless steel finish is easy to clean and will look great for many years to come.

Also Available Matching Vitruvius Cabinet Pull

Specifications of the Stainless Steel Vitruvius Ball Cabinet Knob:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Diameter: 1-1/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
